### Handler protocols (omnibase_spi)
- #47: typed-dynamic pattern — `Mapping[str, JsonValue]` for open-ended payloads, TypedDict for known structures.
- #51: ProtocolHandlerContract interface with behavior descriptors, capability dependencies, execution constraints, and YAML round-trip.
- #69: ProtocolEventPublisher semantics codified — topic override, partition_key policy, 18 unit tests.

### Delegation (omnimarket)
- #3413: completed delegations sent to the acceptance judge via a new compute on the delegate-skill completed terminal.
- #3161: delegate-skill terminal now carries the caller_lane and session_id that issued it.
- #2841: no_escalation declared on the delegate-skill request, passed to dispatch only when true; requires a backend_id pin.
- #3289: routing reducer eligibility now mirrors the dispatched credential path (api_key_env fallback).
- #3466: real redelivery tests moved into the Golden Chain Suite; contract repointed.

### Events, projections & automation
- #2955: emit registry routes hook.event; redaction governs nested members by dotted name; content-captured topic with a scrubbed capture class.
- #3051: lane container memory event projected into lab_container_memory_window (Rule 7a fold plus projection writer).
- #3805: automation-liveness watchdog compute — verdicts, failure episodes, hysteresis, observer-loss folding, planted self-test.
- #3635: node_morning_ground_state_orchestrator registered as an onex.nodes entry point.
- #3710: M4 landing configs derived from each repository's facts; idempotent enqueue.

### Change control & CI
- #1562: test-parallel/tests-integration gated behind non-draft PR state, with a ready_for_review trigger.
- #1713: call-occ-autobind caller added to omnibase_core, the fleet holdout.
- #1717: occ-preflight accepts dependency-pin-only outcomes instead of failing closed.
- #1590: OCC repo matched exactly, not by suffix.
- #3655: shard-plan partition proof moved to the typecheck job.
- #1208: main guard backmerged into the dev promotion lane.

### Runtime & release fixes
- #1655: a def-B single-emit terminal counts as this run's own, not foreign.
- #3274: savings migration and test file shape corrected; relation inventory regenerated.
- #307: sync-only workflow_dispatch retries the idempotent release.yml main sync without republishing.
- #1462: no-hardcoded-ip check scans multiple roots, closing the scripts/ gap.

### Core platform
- #1255: UI contract primitives and EnumEmptyStateReason (Contract-Driven UI Platform, Phase 0).
- #966: substrate gates scaffold and Gate 4 banning silent except: pass.
- #1252: omnibase_core bumped to v0.45.0 after the ModelOnexEnvelope deletion.
- #1324: three omniintelligence url-authority grandfathered reads burned down (215 to 212).

### Repo hygiene & branding
- #363: CodeQL reusable workflow ref moved to omnibase_core.
- #314: omniclaude public-repo-hygiene reusable workflow bump.
- #279: official OmniNode brand picture README header.
